verdict.rationale: Gide's own Intellectual Property practice page lists "know-how, and trade secrets" among its covered rights, so the firm documents trade-secret work in its IP offering. Beyond that single listing nothing is evidenced, and its litigation claims address only patent and trademark cases. missing for 10: confidentiality-program advisory, employee-mobility or non-compete dispute work, trade-secret litigation matters or references, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm documents trade-secret protection work — confidentiality programs, employee-mobility disputes, or trade-secret litigation

citations.quote: patents, trademarks, designs and models, copyright and related rights, know-how, and trade secrets
